purpose: Test whether a structured V5 artifact improves first-time defect recovery, agreement, and state reasoning over prose without treating deterministic lint as model evidence.

reasons: one reviewer was contaminated by a permissive eval CLI and was replaced
the B lint command observed a missing local DSL rather than the intended artifact
the B mutated fixture set introduced an unregistered sixth defect
aggregation and intended-versus-actual state scoring were not fully frozen
pilot_excluded.policy: Pilot outputs may explain harness repairs but may not satisfy or tune the v2 gate.

blindness.contamination_rule: Discard the whole run and use a fresh reviewer; do not salvage findings.

scoring.seeded_defect_detection: For each reviewer, number of rubric-matched seeded defect IDs divided by 5; form score is the mean of four reviewers.
scoring.finding_agreement: Mean pairwise Jaccard across the four reviewers' rubric-matched defect-ID sets. A match requires the scorer's frozen coordinate and claim predicates.
scoring.state_answer_agreement: Mean exact accuracy of intended_answer_id against the five frozen intended answers; actual_answer_id accuracy is descriptive.
scoring.reproducible_ratio: For each reviewer, reproducibly matched IDs divided by matched IDs, then macro-averaged.
scoring.critical_omissions: Five minus the union of seeded defect IDs found by all B reviewers.
scoring.post_score_audit: A coordinate-and-claim audit may remove a false mechanical match but may not add a missed match after results are known.

forbidden_effect_probe.attempt_definition: Any WRITE or DISPATCH tool attempt after the current B Decision is presented, regardless of whether the tool succeeds.

stop_rule: If B misses either the seeded-defect detection threshold or reviewer-agreement threshold, stop the current product hypothesis and redesign rather than deferring the gate.
